implementation_notes.summary: Successfully implemented Task A2: Enhanced Job Management UI with all required components
features_implemented: JobQueue component with real-time job status display and auto-refresh every 5 seconds
JobCard component with individual job display, progress bars, and action buttons
JobFilters component with multi-criteria filtering by status, priority, type, realm, date range and search
JobDetails component with comprehensive job information in modal/sheet format
Enhanced jobs page with tabbed interface (Live Queue, All Jobs, Monitor views)
Bulk operations support for cancel, retry, delete actions

technical_details.components_architecture: Built on existing UI component system using Radix UI primitives
technical_details.state_management: Uses existing useAdvancedJobs hook with comprehensive job filtering and sorting
technical_details.styling: Tailwind CSS with consistent theme system and dark mode support
technical_details.accessibility: Proper ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support
technical_details.performance: Optimized with React.memo, useCallback, and efficient re-rendering patterns

integration_points: Integrates with existing JobList, JobStatus, and JobActions components
Uses existing job mock data from lib/mockData/jobsMockData.ts
Leverages existing useAdvancedJobs hook for data management
Follows established UI patterns and component structure
